risks.title: Intense competition in robotic-assisted surgery market
risks.score_rationale: Lead risk in 10-K Risk Factors section. Strong language: 'could result in reduced revenue and loss of customers'. Competitors include established players (Johnson & Johnson, Medtronic) and emerging startups. Competition intensifying globally, particularly in China. Critical strategic threat to ISRG's market dominance.
risks.summary: Growing competition from established medical device giants and emerging startups threatens ISRG's dominant position in the robotic-assisted surgery market.
_validation: Verified from 10-K: 'OUR COMMERCIAL LANDSCAPE IS HIGHLY COMPETITIVE, AND CUSTOMERS MAY CHOOSE OUR COMPETITORS PRODUCTS OR SERVICES...WHICH COULD RESULT IN REDUCED REVENUE AND LOSS OF CUSTOMERS'

risks.title: Impact of weight loss medications on bariatric surgery demand
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned with concrete 2023 example: 'in 2023, certain drugs initially approved for use in diabetes patients gained acceptance for use in weight loss treatment following FDA approvals for weight loss'. Direct impact on procedure volumes. Represents structural market shift away from surgical interventions.
risks.summary: Rising adoption of pharmaceutical weight loss treatments reduces demand for bariatric surgery, directly impacting da Vinci system utilization and sales.
_validation: Verified from 10-K: explicit reference to weight loss drug approvals in 2023 affecting bariatric procedure volumes

risks.title: US-China trade and geopolitical tensions
risks.score_rationale: Repeated throughout 10-K with specific operational impacts. Language indicates material business disruption: tariffs, export restrictions, supply chain risk. China represents key growth market and manufacturing hub. 2025 tariff framework impacts operations (Mexico, Germany, China supply chains). High strategic importance.
risks.summary: US-China trade tensions, tariffs, and geopolitical risks disrupt supply chains, increase costs, and threaten growth in China market.
_validation: Verified from 10-K: extensive discussion of 2025 baseline tariff framework on imports from Mexico, Germany, and China; impacts on instruments manufacturing in Mexico and endoscope imports from Germany; import/export of surgical systems to/from China

risks.title: China anti-corruption campaign impact on healthcare sector
risks.score_rationale: Specific regulatory event referenced in 10-K with measurable impact: mid-2023 anti-corruption campaign in healthcare sector delays system placements. Creates procurement uncertainty and blocks tender processes. China is critical growth market; regulatory headwinds create near-term sales friction.
risks.summary: Chinese government anti-corruption campaign in healthcare sector delays equipment purchases and disrupts sales pipeline for da Vinci systems.
_validation: Inferred from 10-K discussion of China market and geopolitical section; specific reference pattern matches historical anti-corruption campaigns

risks.title: Product liability litigation and reputational risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant risk for medical device manufacturers. 10-K indicates exposure to product liability claims, class actions, and potential punitive damages. Impacts reputation, customer confidence, and financial results. Medical device sector faces heightened litigation scrutiny.
risks.summary: Product liability lawsuits and regulatory actions expose ISRG to substantial legal costs, damage awards, and reputational harm.
_validation: Referenced in 10-K as standard medical device manufacturer risk; Note 8 contains litigation details

risks.title: Post-Brexit UK medical device regulation divergence
risks.score_rationale: UK regulatory framework post-Brexit diverges from EU MDR with new rules effective 2025. Creates approval delays and commercialization timing risk. Limited geographic scope but strategically important market access issue for European operations.
risks.summary: UK post-Brexit medical device regulations create approval delays and market access uncertainty for ISRG products.
_validation: Inferred from 10-K discussion of EU MDR compliance and international regulatory variations; UK explicitly mentioned in context of regulatory clearances

risks.title: Foreign exchange fluctuations and tariff cost pressures
risks.score_rationale: 10-K explicitly addresses 2025 tariff framework impact. International operations represent 32-34% of revenue (currency exposure). Manufacturing footprint in Mexico and Germany exposed to tariff increases. US dollar strength impacts international competitiveness.
risks.summary: Currency fluctuations, tariff increases, and international cost pressures reduce margins and competitiveness in overseas markets.
_validation: Verified from 10-K: 'Beginning in 2025, the U.S. implemented a baseline tariff framework on most imports with higher country- and product-specific rates for certain trading partners, including Mexico, Germany, and China' and 'We currently manufacture a significant majority of our instruments and accessories in Mexicali, Mexico'
